Title: Selecting an available scheme ticks it and enables Next
Step Expected: The Create New Order page opens.

Step Action: Tick the last scheme in the lists that is enabled and not yet selected.
Step Expected: The scheme is ticked and its month strip appears.
The scheme stays ticked.
Next is enabled.
Nothing else changes.

Title: Next opens the pending order summary with its buttons
Step Expected: The Create New Order page opens.

Step Action: Tick the last scheme in the lists that is enabled and not yet selected.
Step Expected: The scheme is ticked and its month strip appears.
The page title changes to Pending Order.
The Schemes you have selected section is shown.
SUBMIT is disabled; PREVIOUS, SAVE and PRINT are shown.

Title: PREVIOUS returns from the summary to the first step
Step Expected: The Create New Order page opens.

Step Action: Tick the last scheme in the lists that is enabled and not yet selected.
Step Expected: The scheme is ticked and its month strip appears.
The Pending Order summary is shown.
The Create New Order step is shown again.
The scheme is still ticked.

Title: Accepting the terms enables SUBMIT on the summary
Step Expected: The Create New Order page opens.

Step Action: Tick the last scheme in the lists that is enabled and not yet selected.
Step Expected: The scheme is ticked and its month strip appears.
The Pending Order summary is shown.

Step Action: Tick the terms and conditions box.
Step Expected: The page updates.
SUBMIT is enabled.
Nothing is submitted.

Title: SAVE keeps the pending order on the summary
Step Expected: The Create New Order page opens.

Step Action: Tick the last scheme in the lists that is enabled and not yet selected.
Step Expected: The scheme is ticked and its month strip appears.
The Pending Order summary is shown.
The page reloads without an error.
A message says the pending contract order saved successfully.

Title: A customer submits an order and the admin declines it, leaving no order behind
Step Action: As admin, open Manage Contracts > Review Pending Orders and decline any order for QAL/0432.
Step Expected: No order for QAL/0432 is waiting for review.

Step Action: As the customer, open http://localhost:1688/PendingContractOrder.aspx?year=current and tick the last scheme that has a month available to order.
Step Expected: The scheme and its months are ticked.

Step Action: Click Next, tick the terms and conditions and any consent declarations shown.
Step Expected: The Pending Order summary is shown and SUBMIT is enabled.
The customer is returned to Home.

Step Action: As admin, open Review Pending Orders.
Step Expected: An order for QAL/0432 is listed.

Step Action: Open the order with Details and click Decline.
Step Expected: The order is removed from the list.

Step Action: As the customer, open the order page again.
Step Expected: A new order starts with no scheme selected and Next disabled.

Title: Next stays disabled while no scheme is selected
Step Expected: The Create New Order page opens.

Step Action: Untick every scheme that is ticked and enabled.
Step Expected: No scheme is selected.
The page finishes updating.
Next is disabled.

Step Action: Do not click any other button.
Step Expected: Nothing else changes.

Title: Deselecting the only selected scheme disables Next again
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1688/PendingContractOrder.aspx?year=current and untick every selected scheme.
Step Expected: No scheme is selected.

Step Action: Tick the last scheme that has a month available to order.
Step Expected: The scheme and a month are ticked.
Next is enabled.
The scheme is unticked.
Next is disabled.
